thread:
Evan: Quick favor — can someone run perf + profiling for heron-8b (int8 rollout candidate) on sfo-1 GPU pool? Need throughput/regression check vs redwood-7b. Targets: p95 < 220ms for 512 tokens, and >600 tok/s aggregate. Also want KV cache hit profile and cost estimate. Tagging @arjun.

Arjun: On it. I'll queue perf-bot. Any specific prompt mix or batching you want us to use?

Evan: Prompt mix: 80% short (<=64t), 15% mid (256t), 5% long (512t). Baseline batching=8. Please test cache ON and OFF. Capture KV/attn/mem profiles.

Arjun: @perf-bot please run heron-8b quant=int8 batch=8 seq=512 mix=80,15,5 region=sfo-1 cache=[on,off] profile=kv,mem,attn

perf-bot: Queued run id rb-run-1798001. ETA ~12m. Command: ```run_bench --model heron-8b --quant int8 --batch 8 --mix 80,15,5 --seq 512 --region sfo-1 --profile kv,mem,attn```

perf-bot: Done — summary below. Artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/rb-run-1798001.tar.gz
- aggregate throughput (cache=ON, batch=8): 720 tok/s
- p95 latency (512 seq, cache=ON): 200 ms
- p99 latency: 420 ms
- cache=OFF (same batch): throughput 480 tok/s, p95 320 ms
- memory peak: 11.2 GB (per-GPU)
- KV hit-rate: short=96%, mid=78%, long=41%
- est cost (hosted perf profile): $0.85 per 1M tokens
- regression vs redwood-7b baseline: +12% throughput, p95 improved ~15%

Melissa: Nice numbers. Can you upload kernel-level flamegraphs and a lightweight trace? Also what's the latency distribution for short prompts (50th/90th/95th)?

perf-bot: Attached in artifacts: kv_flame.svg, attn_kernels.svg, trace-lite.json. Short prompts latency: p50=28ms, p90=55ms, p95=78ms (cache=ON).

Sofia: If we push int8 in prod, any non-determinism or quality concerns? Did you run eval harness?

Arjun: Ran eval-lite (5k prompts, mix matched to traffic). Generative quality delta: perplexity +0.03; no systematic hallucination uptick in the sample. I'll drop eval summary in the artifacts (eval_summary.csv). Determinism: int8 path is stable on our runtime — occasional tiny token-level diffs but no functional regressions observed.

Evan: Great. Can you draft a rollout recommendation? Thinking canary + fallback to redwood-7b and route-level cache toggles. Also include expected cost delta for dedicated vs hosted.

Arjun: Added notes to ticket RB-4567 (linked in artifacts). Recommendation: canary 5% -> 20% over 48h, monitor p95, token-cost, and quality metrics; automatic fallback to redwood-7b on p95 spike >25% baseline for 15m. Dedicated pool estimate: ~18% cost savings at current commit size vs hosted. I'll open a PR with the rollout config (edge route + feature flag).

Melissa: :thumbsup: Move to release board and schedule a short post-canary review.

Evan: Thanks all — saved artifacts and ticket look good. If Arjun can post the PR link here when ready I'll merge and schedule the canary.

Arjun: Will do, PR up in ~30m (PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/PR-9876).
